instruction: Initiate returns via FedEx for everything in my last 3 amazon order.
notes: Single-app task (amazon). The three most recent orders and every product in them must get a ProductReturn with deliverer FedEx and the item's ordered quantity. Because quantified effects/goals are not allowed, the three orders, their products and the FedEx deliverer are declared as domain constants so that show_orders / show_return_deliverers can assert their ids as ground effects and supervisor-complete-task can list every return as a precondition. The exact number of items per order is only known at runtime (via show_order); the problem uses placeholder items (2,1,2 per order) with static order-contains / item-quantity facts to stand for whatever show_order returns, and the agent loops initiate_return over all order items of each order. show_order gates initiate_return (order-details-known) so product ids and quantities are looked up before returning; known-deliverer gates the deliverer id. No answer is required, so complete_task takes no parameters.
